steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Ohm: V = IR (ohmic) vs non-ohmic (filament, diode); I-V curves

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Series: I same, V splits, R_total = ΣR; Parallel: V same, I splits, 1/R_total = Σ1/R

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Power: P = IV = I^2R = V^2/R; Energy: E = Pt = IVt

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Kirchhoff 1st (junction): ΣI_in = ΣI_out (charge conservation); 2nd (loop): ΣV = 0 (energy conservation)

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: A 12 V battery with internal resistance 0.5 Ω is connected to a 5.5 Ω resistor. Find current, terminal PD, power delivered to load, and power wasted in battery --- Solution: Total R = 6 Ω. I = 12/6 = 2 A. Terminal V = IR_load = 2x5.5 = 11 V. P_load = I^2R = 4x5.5 = 22 W. P_battery = I^2r = 4x0.5 = 2 W. Check: P_total = εI = 24 W = 22+2

steps.title: Lesson plan
steps.body: Starter (5 min): Recall prior knowledge of electricity and circuits with quick questions. Teaching (15 min): Work through each of the learning objectives, explaining principles step by step. Key points review (5 min): Revisit the key points together, confirming understanding.
